prompt.zh-CN: 水分子具有永久偶极矩，最主要的结构原因是什么？
prompt.en-US: What is the main structural reason that a water molecule has a permanent dipole moment?

text.zh-CN: O-H 键有极性且分子呈折线形，偶极不能抵消
text.en-US: Polar O-H bonds and a bent geometry prevent dipole cancellation

text.zh-CN: 水分子是线性的，两个偶极相加
text.en-US: The molecule is linear and its two dipoles add
Each hydrogen carries two negative charges

reveal.zh-CN: 氧的电负性更大，加上孤电子对导致的折线构型，使两个 O-H 键偶极无法完全抵消。
reveal.en-US: Oxygen is more electronegative, and the bent geometry caused by lone pairs keeps the two O-H bond dipoles from canceling.

prompt.zh-CN: 固体 NaCl 通常不导电，而 NaCl 水溶液能导电，关键差别是什么？
prompt.en-US: Solid NaCl usually does not conduct electricity, while aqueous NaCl does. What is the key difference?

text.zh-CN: 固体中离子被晶格束缚，溶液中离子可迁移
text.en-US: Ions are locked in the lattice in the solid but mobile in solution

text.zh-CN: 溶液中的 NaCl 变成了金属
text.en-US: NaCl becomes a metal in solution
The solid contains no charges at all

reveal.zh-CN: 导电需要可移动的载流子；晶体中的离子虽带电但不能自由定向迁移。
reveal.en-US: Conductivity requires mobile charge carriers; ions in the crystal are charged but cannot move freely in a directed way.

title.zh-CN: 石灰水为何先浑浊后澄清

prompt.zh-CN: 持续向石灰水中通入过量 CO2，常见现象是先浑浊后澄清，后一步主要因为生成了什么？
prompt.en-US: When excess CO2 is continuously bubbled through limewater, it may turn cloudy and then clear. What mainly causes the second step?

reveal.zh-CN: 先生成难溶 CaCO3，过量 CO2 和水继续反应形成可溶的 Ca(HCO3)2。
reveal.en-US: Insoluble CaCO3 forms first; excess CO2 and water then produce soluble Ca(HCO3)2.

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是酸性。pH 是化学里的酸碱表情条。
